// The synchronization implementation is included byte-for-byte. Only the
// allocation-only queue adapter injects a safe reserve unwind; unwinding a
// GlobalAlloc::alloc implementation would violate its contract.
mod alloc_crate {
    pub mod boxed { pub use std::boxed::*; }
    pub mod sync { pub use std::sync::Arc; }
    pub mod collections {
        use std::cell::Cell;
        thread_local! { static FAIL: Cell<bool> = const { Cell::new(false) }; }
        pub fn fail_next_reserve() { FAIL.with(|flag| flag.set(true)); }
        pub struct VecDeque<T>(std::collections::VecDeque<T>);
        impl<T> VecDeque<T> {
            pub fn new() -> Self { Self(std::collections::VecDeque::new()) }
            pub fn len(&self) -> usize { self.0.len() }
            pub fn reserve(&mut self, n: usize) {
                if FAIL.with(|flag| flag.replace(false)) { panic!("reserve once"); }
                self.0.reserve(n);
            }
            pub fn push_back(&mut self, value: T) { self.reserve(1); self.0.push_back(value); }
            pub fn pop_front(&mut self) -> Option<T> { self.0.pop_front() }
        }
        impl<T> Default for VecDeque<T> { fn default() -> Self { Self::new() } }
    }
}
mod time { pub use std::time::{Duration,Instant}; }
#[path="__SOURCE__"] mod channel;
use std::sync::{Arc,atomic::{AtomicUsize,AtomicBool,Ordering}};
use std::panic::{catch_unwind,AssertUnwindSafe};
use std::time::Duration;
struct Item { drops:Arc<AtomicUsize>, bomb:Arc<AtomicBool>, value:usize }
impl Drop for Item { fn drop(&mut self){self.drops.fetch_add(1,Ordering::SeqCst);if self.value==1&&self.bomb.swap(false,Ordering::SeqCst){panic!("drop once");}} }
fn main(){
    let drops=Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0));let bomb=Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(true));
    let(tx,rx)=channel::channel();
    for value in 0..5{tx.send(Item{drops:drops.clone(),bomb:bomb.clone(),value}).unwrap();}
    assert!(catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(||drop(rx))).is_err());
    assert_eq!(drops.load(Ordering::SeqCst),5);
    drop(tx.send(Item{drops:drops.clone(),bomb:bomb.clone(),value:9}).unwrap_err());
    assert_eq!(drops.load(Ordering::SeqCst),6);
    for bound in [0,1,3]{
        for _ in 0..300{
            let(tx,rx)=channel::sync_channel(bound);
            let t=std::thread::spawn(move||tx.send(7));
            if bound==0{drop(rx);assert_eq!(t.join().unwrap(),Err(channel::SendError(7)));}
            else{assert_eq!(rx.recv(),Ok(7));assert_eq!(rx.recv(),Err(channel::RecvError));t.join().unwrap().unwrap();}
        }
    }
    for _ in 0..100{
        let(tx,rx)=channel::channel::<u32>();
        let t=std::thread::spawn(move||{std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_micros(10));drop(tx);});
        assert_eq!(rx.recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(2)),Err(channel::RecvTimeoutError::Disconnected));t.join().unwrap();
    }
    let(tx,rx)=channel::sync_channel(0);
    let t=std::thread::spawn(move||rx.recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(1)));
    let mut value=1;
    loop{match tx.try_send(value){Ok(())=>break,Err(channel::TrySendError::Full(v))=>{value=v;std::thread::yield_now();},Err(_)=>panic!("disconnected")}}
    assert_eq!(t.join().unwrap(),Ok(1));
    struct Reenter {
        tx: Option<channel::Sender<Reenter>>,
        sync: Option<channel::SyncSender<Reenter>>,
        drops: Arc<AtomicUsize>,
    }
    impl Drop for Reenter {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            if let Some(tx)=&self.tx { drop(tx.clone()); }
            if let Some(tx)=&self.sync { drop(tx.clone()); }
            self.drops.fetch_add(1,Ordering::SeqCst);
        }
    }
    let count=Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0));
    let(tx,rx)=channel::channel();
    let value=Reenter{tx:Some(tx.clone()),sync:None,drops:count.clone()};
    alloc_crate::collections::fail_next_reserve();
    assert!(catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(||tx.send(value))).is_err());
    assert_eq!(count.load(Ordering::SeqCst),1);
    assert!(matches!(rx.try_recv(),Err(channel::TryRecvError::Empty)));
    for mode in 0..2 {
        let(tx,rx)=channel::sync_channel(1);
        let value=Reenter{tx:None,sync:Some(tx.clone()),drops:count.clone()};
        alloc_crate::collections::fail_next_reserve();
        if mode==0 { assert!(catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(||tx.send(value))).is_err()); }
        else { assert!(catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(||tx.try_send(value))).is_err()); }
        assert!(matches!(rx.try_recv(),Err(channel::TryRecvError::Empty)));
    }
    assert_eq!(count.load(Ordering::SeqCst),3);
    println!("channel panic complete");
}
